passages.title: What Music Do You Like?
passages.body: People like different kinds of music. Some people prefer music that has great lyrics, because the words tell a story. Other people like music that they can dance to. They enjoy fast songs with a strong beat. Some like quiet, smooth music that helps them relax. Others love electronic music that is loud and exciting. There are also people who like singers that play their own instruments. Music is a part of our lives. It can make us happy when we are sad. No matter what kind of music you like, the best music is the music that touches your heart.

passages.title: What Do You Feel Like Watching?
passages.body: When I am tired, I prefer movies that can cheer me up. Comedies like Kung Fu Panda are funny. The characters may not be perfect, but they try their best to solve their problems. After I watch them, my problems suddenly seem less serious, and I feel much better again. I don't often like dramas or documentaries when I am sad or tired. Dramas like Titanic make me feel even sadder. Documentaries like March of the Penguins are slow and quiet. But sometimes, when I am bored, I like to watch movies that are scary. They give me something to think about. Once in a while, scary movies are fun.

passages.title: Sad but Beautiful
passages.body: Abing was a folk musician who was born in the city of Wuxi in 1893. His mother died when he was very young. Abing's father taught him to play many musical instruments. Sadly, Abing later became ill and could not see. Life grew worse for Abing. He was very poor. Not only that, but he developed a serious illness. He had no home. But Abing did not give up. He kept playing music in the streets. In his lifetime, Abing wrote over 600 pieces of music. His most famous piece is Erquan Yingyue. It is a piece that reflects his hard life, but it is also full of hope. Today, Abing's music is loved by people all over the world.

passages.title: Why We Love Music
passages.body: Why do people all over the world love music? One reason is that music can express our feelings. When we are happy, we sing happy songs. When we feel down, sad music helps us. Music can also bring people together. At a concert, thousands of people who don't know each other share the same joy. Music has no language. A person who speaks Chinese and a person who speaks English can enjoy the same song. Music can even help us remember things. A song that we heard long ago can bring back old memories. Music is truly a gift that everyone can enjoy.

passages.title: Different Kinds of Movies
passages.body: There are many kinds of movies, and people enjoy different ones. Comedies are movies that make us laugh. They are great when we want to relax. Action movies are movies that are full of exciting scenes. They often have superheroes who save the world. Documentaries are movies that teach us about real life, like nature or history. Some people find them a little slow, but others love to learn from them. Dramas are movies that show strong feelings. They may make us cry. Scary movies are movies that frighten us. Some people love them, while others can't watch them at all. Which kind of movie do you prefer?

passages.title: School Music Club Notice
passages.body: JOIN THE SCHOOL MUSIC CLUB! Do you love music? Come and join us! WHO CAN JOIN: Any student who enjoys music is welcome. You don't need to be a master. WHAT WE DO: We listen to music that comes from around the world. We also learn to play instruments that are easy for beginners, like the guitar. SPECIAL EVENT: This month, we will watch a documentary that tells the story of Abing, a famous Chinese musician. WHEN: Every Friday, 4:00 p.m. to 5:30 p.m. WHERE: Music Room 203. Come and meet friends who share your love of music. Music is a gift that everyone can enjoy!
